name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.
Unified Obsidian Halo design language: sleek AMOLED styling with theme-adaptive vector icons.
100% vector SVG icons replace system emojis across all tabs, modals, badges, and platform pickers.
Performance & Fluid Motion architecture: default 60 FPS performance mode for low-end devices.
Optional Fluid Motion toggle in Settings with spring touch states and halo lighting.
Optimized RAM and GPU footprint with zero lag on budget Android chipsets.
